Its large-a and large-x controls, compact-uniform x-to-zero limit, and unique maximizer of B(a) then force x_j->0 and a_j->a0 for every sequence with P(a_j,x_j)->C0. Exact source parameter identities transfer these limits to pseudo-hyperbolic separation and normalized Bloch level.

value.rationale: The motivating paper has just identified the sharp constant and proves sharpness only through an infinitesimal limiting example. Determining attainment and the geometry of arbitrary near-extremizers is a natural next extremal question. The finding proves that every finite pair is strictly subextremal and that every extremizing sequence must collapse at one unique normalized Bloch level, furnishing a precise compactness obstruction relevant to future stability theory.
